title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) Letter Standards
content:
Every letter on a Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) case is sent by the program's notice channel in the patient's preferred language when it is one of the notice languages, otherwise in English.

| Letter | Contents |
|---|---|
| Missing-information notice | lists each missing document and the response deadline, and encloses the plain-language summary |
| Approval letter | states the tier, the award start date, the award end date and, for medical hardship, the liability cap |
| Denial letter | states the denial reason and the right to reconsideration |
| Renewal reminder | sent the award renewal window days before the award end date |

A notice of one type is sent once per date on a case.

### Language of a letter (hypothetical preferred languages)

| Patient's preferred language | Letter language |
|---|---|
| Spanish (a notice language) | Spanish |
| Hmong (a notice language) | Hmong |
| any language that is not a notice language | English |
